# Healthy.io

> Healthy.io is a digital-health company that turns an ordinary smartphone camera into a
> clinical-grade measurement device, using colorimetric analysis, computer vision and machine
> learning. Its Minuteful product line covers home urinalysis for chronic kidney disease,
> urinary tract infection testing, a ten-parameter urinalysis panel, and digitized chronic
> wound assessment. It sells to health systems, provider groups and payers.

**This file was generated by API Evangelist, not by Healthy.io.** Healthy.io does not publish
an llms.txt (https://healthy.io/llms.txt returns 404, probed 2026-08-22). It is assembled from
Healthy.io's own public pages and from probes recorded in this repository.

## API status

**Healthy.io publishes no public API.** As of 2026-08-22 there is no developer portal, no API
reference, no OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL/WSDL/Protobuf contract, no SDK, no MCP server and no A2A
agent card at any Healthy.io host. Two developer-adjacent hosts exist but are closed:

- `docs.healthy.io` — 302 redirects every path to `healthyio.cloudflareaccess.com` SSO login
- `status.healthy.io` — same Cloudflare Access wall

The company's homepage states its technology "can be seamlessly integrated into most EMRs
SMART on FHIR", but no FHIR CapabilityStatement, `/.well-known/smart-configuration` or public
FHIR endpoint is served (all probed, all 404). Treat the SMART on FHIR support as a sales claim
to verify with the company, not as a callable surface.

Do not attempt to discover or call a Healthy.io API from this file. There is nothing to call.

## Products

- [Minuteful Kidney](https://healthy.io/services/kidney/): home urine albumin-to-creatinine
  ratio (ACR) testing for chronic kidney disease. FDA 510(k) cleared for home use, CE marked.
- [Minuteful for Wound](https://healthy.io/services/wound/): digitized chronic wound
  measurement and assessment.
- [Minuteful UTI](https://healthy.io/services/uti/): urinary tract infection testing.
- [Minuteful 10](https://healthy.io/services/ten/): ten-parameter urinalysis panel.
- [minuteful.com](https://minuteful.com): patient-facing product site.

## Company

- [Homepage](https://healthy.io/)
- [About us](https://healthy.io/about-us/): offices in Boston, London and Tel Aviv.
- [Contact us](https://healthy.io/contact-us/)

  developers". One public repository (an Android multi-touch UI library, last released
  2022-08-31). No API client SDKs.

## Trust, security and compliance

This is the richest public machine-reachable surface Healthy.io publishes — 60+ crawlable
pages, no login required.

- [Trust Center](https://healthy.io/trust-center/)
- [Security](https://healthy.io/trust-center/security)
- [Privacy](https://healthy.io/trust-center/privacy)
- [Compliance](https://healthy.io/trust-center/compliance)
- [Availability](https://healthy.io/trust-center/availability)
- [Certifications](https://healthy.io/trust-center/compliance/certifications): ISO/IEC
  27001:2013, ISO 22301:2019, ISO 13485:2016, HITRUST Validated Assessment, UK Cyber
  Essentials (2022-2023), NHS Data Security and Protection Toolkit (2022-23).
- Regulatory programs: HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, NHS DTAC, Anti-Kickback and Stark Laws.
- No SOC 2 report is named anywhere on the trust center.

## Reporting a security vulnerability

- Policy: https://healthy.io/trust-center/security/reporting-suspected-vulnerabilities
- Contact: security@healthy.io
- Non-automated acknowledgement within 24 hours; progress updates at least every five working
  days; severity scored with CVSS 2.0; public notification coordinated with the reporter.
- There is no bug bounty program, and no `/.well-known/security.txt` is served (404), so this
  contact is not discoverable from a well-known location.

## Notes for agents

- `research.healthy.io` answers HTTP 200 with an identical 13,828-byte SPA shell for **every**
  path, including `/openapi.json`, `/graphql` and every `/.well-known/*` path. Any "discovery"
  from that host is a false positive. Do not treat a 200 from it as a document.
- `https://blog.healthy.io`, linked from the site footer, returns HTTP 500.
- `*.dynamic-env.healthy.io` hosts appearing in certificate transparency logs are ephemeral CI
  preview environments, not products.
